camel_example: aliyun ehpcinstant TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'job-xxxxxxxx' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType Job
description_en: Create and bind tags to Instant resource list
description_zh: 为Instant资源列表统一创建并绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun ehpcinstant tag-resources --resource-type Job --resource-id job-xxxxxxxx --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

Job
Executor
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义。取值范围：
Job
Executor
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表。N 的取值范围为：1~50
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The key of the tag. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://. The tag key cannot start with acs: or aliyun
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以 aliyun 和 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或 https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag. You can specify empty strings as tag values. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the replication pair-consistent group. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag
